title: cutwater version manifest
description: The released version of every unit, in `.cutwater/versions.toml`. Only `cutwater init` and `cutwater version` write it.

units.description: The released version of each unit, by unit name.

version.description: The version the unit's files declared.

anyOf.description: The version the unit's last release published.

A version `init` took from the unit's files when the repository
adopted cutwater. It counts as released but was never tagged; the
unit's next release replaces the entry with an ordinary one.
